title: How to help
lead: Three ways to help: on the ground, with materials, or with a gift.
paragraphs: The priority now is to rebuild the house. You can help by clearing debris, bringing materials, or transferring from Argentina or Chile.

This page does not take money: it does not ask for card details, it does not process payments and it does not charge a fee. If the bank details you see do not match the ones we share, do not transfer.
afterTransfer: You do not need to let us know. If you would rather your gift stay anonymous, it already is: we do not publish names or individual amounts.
